scores.justification: The hash map + doubly linked list implementation is textbook-correct: dict gives O(1) lookup, dummy head/tail simplify list surgery, `get` returns None on miss and calls `_move_to_front`, and eviction reads `self.tail.prev` in O(1). The one real defect is the degenerate `capacity=0` (or negative) case: `put` would try `del self.cache[lru_node.key]` on the dummy head node, raising KeyError, and there is no capacity validation. Naming, docstrings, and the private helper factoring are clean and idiomatic, and the complexity claims stated are accurate.
